mapper.sql: lm_inspect_material.id, lm_inspect_material.category_id, lm_inspect_material.principal_material_id, lm_inspect_material.name, lm_inspect_material.code, lm_inspect_material.specification, lm_inspect_material.is_sub_material, lm_inspect_material.status, lm_inspect_material.merge_code, lm_inspect_material.package_count, lm_inspect_material.unit_id, lm_inspect_material.extend_unit_id, lm_inspect_material.description, lm_inspect_material.platform_material_id, lm_inspect_material.expand_info, lm_inspect_material.remark, lm_inspect_material.create_by, lm_inspect_material.update_by, lm_inspect_material.create_time, lm_inspect_material.update_time, lm_inspect_material.is_deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM lm_inspect_material left join lm_inspect_material_category c ON lm_inspect_material.category_id = c.id
INNER JOIN lm_document_material dm ON lm_inspect_material.id = dm.product_id INNER JOIN lm_document_config dc ON dm.config_id = dc.id AND dc.status = 1 AND dc.is_deleted = 0
AND c.category_type = #{param.categoryType}
AND lm_inspect_material.category_id in
#{id}
AND lm_inspect_material.package_count > 0
AND lm_inspect_material.package_count = 0
AND lm_inspect_material.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.name},'%')
AND lm_inspect_material.merge_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.mergeCode}, '%')
AND (lm_inspect_material.merge_code like CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR lm_inspect_material.name like CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%'))
AND lm_inspect_material.specification LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.specification}, '%')
AND lm_inspect_material.status = #{param.status}
AND lm_inspect_material.platform_material_id in
#{item}
AND lm_inspect_material.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY ${param.sortOrder}

SELECT p.*, (CASE WHEN p.package_count > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS packageFlag, c.name AS categoryName FROM lm_inspect_material p LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material_category c ON p.category_id = c.id
AND p.category_type = #{param.categoryType}
AND p.category_id in
#{id}
AND p.package_count > 0
AND p.package_count = 0
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.name},'%')
AND p.merge_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.mergeCode}, '%')
AND (p.merge_code like CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%') OR p.name like CONCAT('%', #{param.keyword}, '%'))
AND p.specification LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.specification}, '%')
AND p.platform_material_id in
#{item}
AND p.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY ${param.sortOrder}

select id, code, name, merge_code from lm_inspect_material where is_deleted = 0 and is_sub_material = false
and status = 1
and category_id = #{materialCategoryId}
order by merge_code asc
